cards.example_en: Nobody offered a solution until my partner raised her hand.
cards.example_zh: 直到我的搭档举手，才有人提出解决方法。

cards.example_en: Somehow the classroom door opened by itself.
cards.example_zh: 不知怎么的，教室的门自己开了。

cards.example_en: The box is somewhat heavy.
cards.example_zh: 这个盒子有点重。

cards.example_en: The letter was full of sorrow.
cards.example_zh: 信里充满悲伤。

cards.example_en: Which sort of sandwich do you want in your lunchbox?
cards.example_zh: 你想在午餐盒里放哪种三明治？

cards.example_en: Quiet music can calm your soul before a big exam.
cards.example_zh: 大考之前，安静的音乐能让灵魂平静下来。

cards.example_en: The green apple tastes sour.
cards.example_zh: 青苹果尝起来是酸的。

cards.example_en: Old newspapers were the source of our history project.
cards.example_zh: 旧报纸是我们历史课题的资料来源。

cards.example_en: Southern cities stay warm even in late December.
cards.example_zh: 南方的城市即使到十二月下旬也很暖和。

cards.example_en: Farmers sow wheat in autumn.
cards.example_zh: 农民在秋天播种小麦。

cards.example_en: The guest speaker showed photos of her village school.
cards.example_zh: 嘉宾演讲者展示了她乡村学校的照片。

cards.example_en: A heart specialist told Grandpa to walk every day.
cards.example_zh: 心脏专家让爷爷每天都去散步。

cards.example_en: This rare species nests only on the island cliffs.
cards.example_zh: 这个稀有物种只在岛上的悬崖筑巢。

cards.example_en: The coach set a specific time for the extra practice.
cards.example_zh: 教练为加练定了一个具体的时间。

cards.example_en: We had a splendid view of the lake.
cards.example_zh: 我们看到了极好的湖景。

cards.example_en: A local sponsor paid for the prizes.
cards.example_zh: 一位本地赞助者支付了奖品费用。

cards.example_en: We picked a shady spot and ate lunch on the grass.
cards.example_zh: 我们挑了一处阴凉的地方，坐在草地上吃午饭。

cards.example_en: The film is about a spy in wartime.
cards.example_zh: 这部电影讲的是战争时期的一名间谍。

cards.example_en: The country needs political stability.
cards.example_zh: 国家需要政治稳定。

cards.example_en: The new stadium holds 50,000 people.
cards.example_zh: 新体育场能容纳五万人。

cards.example_en: Kitchen staff prepared sandwiches for the sports day.
cards.example_zh: 厨房人员为运动会准备了三明治。

cards.example_en: Hold the rail on the stair.
cards.example_zh: 在楼梯上扶好栏杆。

cards.example_en: Don't stare at people.
cards.example_zh: 不要盯着人看。

cards.example_en: Nobody should starve in a rich city.
cards.example_zh: 在富裕的城市里不应该有人挨饿。

cards.example_en: One statistic stood out in the report.
cards.example_zh: 报告里有一项数据很突出。

cards.example_en: There is a statue of a famous poet in the square.
cards.example_zh: 广场上有一座著名诗人的雕像。

cards.example_en: We grilled one steak and plenty of corn outside.
cards.example_zh: 我们在外面烤了一块牛排，还有不少玉米。

cards.example_en: Steam rose from the hot soup.
cards.example_zh: 热汤冒出蒸汽。

cards.example_en: Workers painted the steel bridge blue last month.
cards.example_zh: 工人们上个月把那座钢铁桥漆成了蓝色。

cards.example_en: Good questions stimulate thinking.
cards.example_zh: 好问题能激发思考。

cards.example_en: I have a stomachache after lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭后我胃痛。

cards.example_en: The instructions are straightforward.
cards.example_zh: 说明很直白。

cards.example_en: Ships pass through the narrow strait.
cards.example_zh: 船只穿过狭窄的海峡。

cards.example_en: Don't follow a stranger.
cards.example_zh: 不要跟陌生人走。

cards.example_en: We need a new marketing strategy.
cards.example_zh: 我们需要新的营销策略。

cards.example_en: A clear stream ran through the wood.
cards.example_zh: 一条清澈的小溪穿过树林。

cards.example_en: She pushed the stuck door with all her strength.
cards.example_zh: 她使出全部力气去推那扇卡住的门。

cards.example_en: Daily practice will strengthen your memory.
cards.example_zh: 每天练习会增强记忆。

cards.example_en: Runners stretch their legs before they leave the track.
cards.example_zh: 跑步的人离开跑道前会伸展双腿。

cards.example_en: Lightning may strike the tall tree behind the gym.
cards.example_zh: 闪电可能会击中体育馆后面的大树。

cards.example_en: This kite needs new string before it can fly again.
cards.example_zh: 这只风筝得换上新细线，才能再飞起来。

cards.example_en: Label the structure of the flower on your diagram.
cards.example_zh: 在你的图上标出这朵花的结构。

cards.example_en: Some students struggle with long division at first.
cards.example_zh: 有些学生一开始做长除法时很吃力。

cards.example_en: They record the school podcast in a tiny studio.
cards.example_zh: 他们在一间很小的工作室里录制学校播客。

cards.example_en: Leave wet sports stuff outside the classroom door.
cards.example_zh: 把湿的运动用品放在教室门外。

cards.example_en: Leaving my phone on the bus was a stupid mistake.
cards.example_zh: 把手机落在公交车上是个愚蠢的错误。

cards.example_en: Taste is subjective.
cards.example_zh: 口味是主观的。

cards.example_en: Candidates submit their forms to the office by Thursday.
cards.example_zh: 考生须在星期四前把表格提交到办公室。

cards.example_en: I subscribe to a science magazine.
cards.example_zh: 我订阅了一本科学杂志。

cards.example_en: Subsequent lessons built on the grammar from Monday.
cards.example_zh: 随后的课都建立在星期一学的语法之上。

word.example_en: Do not stare at strangers on the bus.
word.example_zh: 不要在公交车上盯着陌生人看。
